name: NFL Extra Points Visa Credit Card

localized_names.en: NFL Extra Points Visa Credit Card

base_rate.description: 1% cash back on all other purchases

categories.label: NFL purchases (NFLShop.com, NFL stadium purchases, NFL tickets via NFL Team Ticket Offices, Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, Sports Illustrated Tickets)

rewards.redemption_notes: Offer is exclusive to NFL Extra Points Visa Credit Card holders enrolled in the NFL Extra Points Rewards program. Rewards program provided by Comenity Capital Bank; full terms at comenity.net/nflvisa. Cash back redeemable as statement credits.

signup_bonus.description: Earn up to $100 cash back as a welcome offer for new cardholders enrolled in the NFL Extra Points Rewards program. Offer excludes NFL purchases. Valid one time only.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: No annual fee associated with the NFL Extra Points card.

benefits.title: Team Branded Card Design
benefits.description: Choose your favorite NFL team's card design to represent your team affiliation within the NFL Extra Points Visa Credit Card program.

notes: Issued by Comenity Capital Bank. Originally issued by Barclays; moved to Comenity in 2022. Currently a Visa product; certain NFL cards are scheduled to move to the American Express network starting August 20, 2026, with new rebranded NFL Extra Points American Express Credit Cards arriving by September 13, 2026 — the account will still be issued by Comenity Capital Bank. Rewards terms at comenity.net/nflvisa.
